defensives.name: Shield Block
defensives.usage_rule: Your primary mitigation at 30 Rage and 2 charges: keep it up whenever something is actually meleeing you, delay it into known blockable hits or long boss casts, and bank toward 2 charges before you taunt back in.

defensives.name: Shield Wall
defensives.usage_rule: 40% reduction for 8 seconds: pre-plan it for a known spike or a non-blockable damage window rather than reacting to a low health bar.

defensives.name: Demoralizing Shout
defensives.usage_rule: Cuts the damage the pack deals to you by 20% for 8 seconds, so hold it for the heavy melee window when you have nothing else available.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: 20% magic reduction for 5 seconds: use it as your magic-damage button, and save the reflect for the rare boss or dungeon spell that can actually be sent back, remembering the buff drops the moment you reflect.

defensives.name: Last Stand
defensives.usage_rule: 30% max health instantly healed for 8 seconds: press it as the recovery button after a spike lands, or stack it with Shield Wall when you need to eat a hit you cannot mitigate.

defensives.name: Rallying Cry
defensives.usage_rule: 10% temporary health for the whole group: plan it into a raid-wide damage event rather than pressing it for yourself.

defensives.name: Impending Victory
defensives.usage_rule: 10 Rage for 30% of your max health: press it whenever you are chipped and the Rage is not needed for Shield Block.
